1.consolidated_definition: Se dice del tocón duro que no ha empezado a podrir.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This is said of the hard stump that has not begun to rot.

Alternatively:

It refers to a hard stump that has not started to decay.

Or more formally:

Designated for a hardwood stump that has not yet commenced to decompose.
